changes: STATIC manifest interfaces are schema-constrained callable signatures, excluding module declarations, assignments and source bodies before decoding. Non-static/JVM planned-file interfaces retain their previous grammar.

Manifest and child requests carry an explicit policy-owned classic/CommonJS runtime contract. The manifest contract advances to V13; every V12 prototype screen/element marker and binding instruction remains present.
Node parser failures retain only a safe reason code, input mode and line number; no raw stderr, source text or process paths are exposed as diagnostic fields.

One existing syntax retry receives the safe diagnostic and an unchanged bounded prior-source excerpt/hash in its audited system_instruction. The existing four-field syntax_retry context and DB lineage contract remain unchanged; no migration or evidence rewriting is needed.
The CommonJS instruction is conditional on WEB_STATIC. Other execution targets preserve the actual parser input mode and permit valid ES-module declarations.

validation.database_scope: No DB mutation or migration performed. Exact existing retry-context shape and equality outside syntax_retry are covered by the audited request unit regression; PostgreSQL integration tests were not rerun in this bounded fix.

limitations: Historical manifest and both failed app.js responses remain rejected and unchanged. No source revision or accepted file was fabricated.
